frame: x east, n north (three z = -n), metres
dtype: int16 little-endian row-major (n rows, x columns)
interpolation: bilinear on the 0.5 m grid; missing corners replaced by the mean of the valid ones; heights over the town paving come from the 0.2 m town grid (max of both)
masks: island-mask.bin uint8, nearest cell: bit2 = the town grid authored a surface (walkable by the town rules); bit0 walkable (supported, >= 1.2 m inside the rim, slope <= 0.90); bit1 comfortable (slope <= 0.60, >= 2.5 m inside the rim)

derived_bounds.note: the controller's bounds are symmetric about the origin: ceil(max |x|, |z| over all geometry) + 10 m
